description: This file defines a Java interface 'SignalMapper' that provides a contract for converting signals of a generic type into 'Adaptable' objects within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter, particularly for handling different signal types such as thing or policy signals.

classes.name: SignalMapper
classes.description: A Java interface for mapping signals to adaptable objects in the Ditto protocol integration.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a signal of generic type T and a channel into an Adaptable object.
